name: @syneva/web
description: The web side of Syneva (RFC 0001, phase 2): a Cloudflare Worker and one UserHub Durable Object per account, the switchboard that shows a paired local hub on syneva.dev. Sign-in by magic link, device-code pairing, the hub and tab sockets, the HTTP relay and the breaker; the frontend's bundle served as static assets.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
